Chapter 12. Domestic Relations

§ 12.350 Parenting time.

(1) The court shall presume that equal parenting time is in the best interest of the child.

(2) A parent may rebut the presumption with evidence, and the court must make written findings supporting any departure from equal parenting time.

(3) This section does not apply where the court has found a pattern of domestic abuse under § 12.355.

Current through 2026 Exampleland Act 12; published September 1, 2026.

History: 2021 Act 9; 2026 Act 12.
